text_en: And I said: Listen, you heads of Jacob and rulers of the house of Israel! Should you not know justice? —
text_cn: 我曾经说过：“雅各伯的首领，以色列家的官吏，请你们倾听！认识正义，岂不是你们分内的事？”

text_en: you who hate the good and love the evil, who tear the skin off my people, and the flesh off their bones;
text_cn: 然而他们恶善好恶，从平民身上剥下他们的皮，从骨头上剔下他们的肉。

text_en: who eat the flesh of my people, flay their skin off them, break their bones in pieces, and chop them up like meat in a kettle, like flesh in a caldron.
text_cn: 他们吞食我百姓的肉，剥去他们的皮，折断他们的骨头，将他们切成碎块，如釜中的肉，如鼎中的肉。

text_en: Then they will cry to the Lord , but he will not answer them; he will hide his face from them at that time, because they have acted wickedly.
text_cn: 当他们呼求上主时，上主决不俯听他们；反要掩面不理他们，因为他们行了穷凶极恶的事。

text_en: Thus says the Lord concerning the prophets who lead my people astray, who cry “Peace” when they have something to eat, but declare war against those who put nothing into their mouths.
text_cn: 论及迷惑我百姓的先知，上主这样说：当他们的牙齿有咀嚼的东西时，他们便呼喊：“和平。”但凡不将食物送到他们口上的，他们便宣布：“战争。”

text_en: Therefore it shall be night to you, without vision, and darkness to you, without revelation. The sun shall go down upon the prophets, and the day shall be black over them;
text_cn: 因此，为你们只有黑夜而没有神视，只有黑暗而没有神谕；太阳必为先知而没落，白昼必为他们而变为黑暗。

text_en: the seers shall be disgraced, and the diviners put to shame; they shall all cover their lips, for there is no answer from God.
text_cn: 先知必将抱愧，巫士必将蒙羞，他们都要掩住自己的胡须，因为没有天主的答复。

text_en: But as for me, I am filled with power, with the spirit of the Lord , and with justice and might, to declare to Jacob his transgression and to Israel his sin.
text_cn: 至于我，我因上主的神而充满力量、正义和勇气，向雅各伯指出她的邪恶，向以色列说明她的罪过。

text_en: Hear this, you rulers of the house of Jacob and chiefs of the house of Israel, who abhor justice and pervert all equity,
text_cn: 雅各伯家的首领，以色列家的官吏，请你们倾听这事！你们憎恶正义，曲解一切正理；

text_en: who build Zion with blood and Jerusalem with wrong!
text_cn: 你们以血债建筑熙雍，用邪恶建设耶路撒冷。

text_en: Its rulers give judgment for a bribe, its priests teach for a price, its prophets give oracles for money; yet they lean upon the Lord and say, “Surely the Lord is with us! No harm shall come upon us. ”
text_cn: 她的首领为贿赂而审判，司祭为薪俸而设教，先知为银钱而占卜，尚依赖上主说：“上主不是在我们中间吗？灾祸决不会临于我们身上！”

text_en: Therefore because of you Zion shall be plowed as a field; Jerusalem shall become a heap of ruins, and the mountain of the house a wooded height.
text_cn: 因此，为了你们的缘故，熙雍必被耕耘有如一块田地，耶路撒冷必成为一堆废墟，圣殿山必成为丛林中的一个丘陵。
